newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania central bank cuts one-week rate to 48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania central bank cuts one-week rate to 48 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said it had cut by two percentage points to 48 percent the minimum permitted rate for its one-week refinancing funds put on offer at Thursday's auction.
It also raised the amount on offer to 1.18 trillion lei from last week's 1.045 trillion.
Traders said the downward move was in line with a slide of short-term prices to some 43-44 percent from 48 percent last week on a money market saturated with leu funds.
But they said the slide might affect the leu currency, which is facing increased pressure from rising dollar buiyng orders on a forex market plagued for months with shortages.
Auction results are expected on FXRP later on Thursday or early on Friday. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
